episodes.synopsis: After weeks at sea, Lili Ichijoin finally arrives in London. She ends up lost, but a stranger shows the way to the academy — and a breathtaking sketch.
episodes.title: Black Bread and Iridescent Hope

episodes.synopsis: Lili adjusts to her new life and tackles her first assignment: painting the sky. As she ponders the theme, she notices that her blue paint is missing.
episodes.title: Feeling Blue

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to unearth the secret behind Kit's talent, Lili joins his quest to find the cave, but instead she discovers the beauty of the English countryside.
episodes.title: Lilies

episodes.synopsis: Lili hides her struggles in letters home. While preparing for a prestigious competitive show, she has a fateful meeting with a new student from Japan.
episodes.title: His Rough Sketch

episodes.synopsis: The group visits Kit's sprawling family estate in the Lake District. There, Lili catches a glimpse of the pressures he faces as an aristocrat.
episodes.title: Views of a Honey Gold Summer

episodes.synopsis: After an afternoon with Kit's prized mare, the group attends a lavish ball, but Lili is missing. When Kit learns why, he arranges a surprise.
episodes.title: An Asymmetrical World

episodes.synopsis: Back in London and desperate to make ends meet, Lili drowns in work with no time to paint until Catherine suddenly appears with a lucrative proposal.
episodes.title: A Red Rose Has Thorns

episodes.synopsis: While Lili paints the portrait over and over again, their initial friction fades as Catherine opens up. Later, Lili overhears a startling confession.
episodes.title: The Perspective of Childhood Friends

episodes.synopsis: As she watches him leave, Catherine thinks back on her childhood with Kit. Lili finds Peter brooding over his lack of talent, which soon boils over.
episodes.title: A Gradation of Talent and Effort

episodes.synopsis: After her outburst, Kit disappears, leaving Lili wracked with guilt. Shin takes her out to cheer her up. Later, Catherine drags her to Astoria House.
episodes.title: Outlines of Triangles

episodes.synopsis: Catherine stands up to Richard and stands up for her new friend. Thinking that Kit has been locked away, Lili rushes to Drunnheim Hall to rescue him.
episodes.title: A Portrait in Sepia

episodes.synopsis: Though it's her last chance to prove herself and stay in London, Lili abandons the final assignment and races to find Kit, who's absent from class.
episodes.title: The Golden Ratio Between Them

episodes.synopsis: During a weekend in Dorothy's hometown, Lili faces her feelings. When they return to school, she's shocked by the results of the final assignment.
episodes.title: A Collage of Joy and Sorrow

episodes.synopsis: While Lili sends a victory letter home, Kit faces the weight of aristocratic duty as Richard shares his worries about their role in the looming conflict.
episodes.title: Farewell on the Sea

episodes.synopsis: Despite a sense of unease, everyone works on their final pieces as Kit attempts a brand new approach. Shin receives a confusing telegram from home.
episodes.title: Stormy Crossroads

episodes.synopsis: Lili also receives orders to return to Japan. In the rain, she searches for Kit, hoping for one more chance to tell him how she truly feels.
episodes.title: Colorless Cubism of the Heart

episodes.synopsis: As Lili prepares to depart, Peter also announces his plans to transfer. At their farewell party, Catherine arrives with news: Kit's ship is leaving now!
episodes.title: A Confession Gone with the Waves

episodes.synopsis: Five years later. After receiving devastating news, Lili gives up on her two loves: Kit and painting, and seeks solace in Shin. He proposes to her.
episodes.title: Five Years Later, an Engagement Ring

episodes.synopsis: Lili stumbles upon an important letter and confronts Shin. After he reveals his strange sighting, they comb the harbour for Kit, hoping for a reunion.
episodes.title: Drawn by Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Resolving to pursue art again, Lili and Shin break off their engagement. Meanwhile, Kit returns home. Will the two star-crossed lovers ever reunite?
episodes.title: Love Through a Prism
